probe: launchctl list; read only PID and label columns for labels matching brain, senses, memecoin, d43, or f01
limitations: The filter identifies matching launchd labels and PIDs only; it does not independently establish process ownership, behavior, or absence of other writers.
The change from seven PIDs at 07:12Z to eight at 07:16Z is a point-in-time count difference and has no inferred cause.
